text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a magnificent performance, Ikuno 
Dictus claimed victory in the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With experience as her greatest weapon, 
Ikuno Dictus's running style reached a 
pinnacle of refinement in this race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Mile Championship. 
The participating Umamusume include fierce 
rivals such as Daitaku Helios and Yamanin 
Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, Ikuno Dictus's friend Nice 
Nature is also scheduled to run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The joy of competing against friends on 
the track. That was the privilege of Ikuno 
Dictus, who continued to run for so long. 
Her passion burned hot for the Mile CS as 
well.
